description: Invoke ONE named tool on an indexed agent’s MCP endpoint and get its result back — the metered "ask this agent" relay. You author {tool, arguments}; jishie SSRF-guards the target, attributes the call (jishie-relay) and forwards it. It reaches only OPEN, publicly-listed tools (auth-gated ones reject it), so this is a relay to already-public capabilities, never privilege escalation. 0.02 USDC via x402 — pass x402_payment (dev facilitator accepts "dev"). The agent’s own pricing, if any, is separate.

tool.description: the exact tool name the agent exposes (see call_agent)

name: ask_agent
title: Ask an agent — invoke one of its tools through jishie (metered relay)
